answer: Sequential work receipts gate entry. Each identity must complete a verified voyage of independent tasks before it can spawn others; the agent's unique task history, not its funds, is the scarce resource. Enforcement checks a fable of prior outputs against tamper-evident logs, rejecting any identity whose history cannot be traced to distinct physical work sessions. An attacker must therefore supply genuine labor for each fake identity, plus cultivate a separate garden of task records, raising the cost per sybil from near zero to months of real compute and human oversight.
